traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets imagination. Idealism and vision on a large scale. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of growth and imagination is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Inspired vision; test it against logic before committing.
shadow: Excess and overreach fused with illusion and escapism, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.
base: Hope can grow faster than the facts when one possibility seems capable of solving several problems at once.

readerCopy.body: Hope can grow faster than the facts when one possibility seems capable of solving several problems at once. When Jupiter conjoins Neptune, optimism and imagination expand together, making a promise, idea, or opportunity feel larger before its limits are clear. If you find yourself treating enthusiasm as confirmation, notice what has actually been promised, priced, or agreed to. The vision can still matter without asking excitement to supply the missing facts.
